command:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='references/project-standards.md'; s=open(p).read()
old='ACTION: (1) Commit each task on the working branch as it is finished, after its own gate and adversarial pass; open one pull request for the branch and add each task to its body; do not wait for a merge between tasks.'
new='ACTION: (1) Finish each task on the working branch (its own gate, adversarial pass and repairs, each a commit) before the next; open one pull request for the branch and add each task to its body; do not wait for a merge between tasks.'
assert s.count(old)==1; open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
PY
STEM="session_$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)-remediation-stack"; mkdir -p "scratchpad/$STEM" && echo "$STEM" > scratchpad/CURRENT && cat scratchpad/CURRENT && ls -d scratchpad/$(cat scratchpad/CURRENT)
export SCRATCH="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/guidebook-t-006"; CHECKS="test_run_pipeline_refusals test_db_amend_writers test_scan_contract test_author_presence test_search_log_completeness test_assess_cell_pilot"
for c in $CHECKS; do cmd=$(python3 -c "import yaml,sys,shlex;print(shlex.join(next(x['cmd'] for x in yaml.safe_load(open('governance/check-registry.yaml'))['checks'] if x['id']==sys.argv[1])))" $c); timeout 500 $cmd > "$SCRATCH/after2-$c.txt" 2>&1; echo "$c rc=$? | $(grep -E 'EXAMINED|RESULTS|FAILED' "$SCRATCH/after2-$c.txt" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-80) | failing-diff: $(diff <(grep -E '\[✗\]|^ *FAIL|^FAILED|VERDICT: FAIL' "$SCRATCH/before-$c.txt") <(grep -E '\[✗\]|^ *FAIL|^FAILED|VERDICT: FAIL' "$SCRATCH/after2-$c.txt") >/dev/null && echo none || echo DIFFERS)"; done; echo graph: $(python3 workplan/pipeline-state-graph/build_graph.py --check 2>&1 | tail -1); sha256sum data/guidebook.db | cut -c1-16; (scripts/preflight.sh --base origin/main --explain > "$SCRATCH/gate2.txt" 2>&1; echo "gate rc=$?" >> "$SCRATCH/gate2.txt") >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo gate started

export SCRATCH="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/guidebook-t-006"; for i in $(seq 1 58); do grep -q 'gate rc=' $SCRATCH/gate2.txt 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 10; done; grep -E '^(RESULT|PREFLIGHT|SELFTEST)|FAIL|NOTHING-IN-SCOPE|gate rc|changed file' $SCRATCH/gate2.txt | cut -c1-120
